name: American Professional Agency
short_description: Program administrator for malpractice programs for psychiatrists (APA members), psychologists, counselors, MFTs and students; claims-made with no deductible.
long_description: American Professional Agency, Inc. is an insurance agency and program administrator, not the carrier. It runs the malpractice program selected by the American Psychiatric Association for its members (membership required) and states it is the exclusive program administrator for the American Psychological Association's professional liability program, where membership is optional but members get a 20% discount. Its mental health counselor and marriage and family therapist program is underwritten by Allied World Insurance Company and does not require association membership. The counselor policy is claims-made with standard limits of $1M per incident/$3M aggregate (up to $2M/$4M available), no deductible, and $5,000 of licensing-board defense with no annual aggregate, raisable to $150,000 for an extra charge. Prior-acts coverage is offered to clinicians switching from another carrier. The tail (extended reporting period) costs 200% of the expiring premium, but is free on death, permanent disability, or retirement at 55 or older after five years on the policy. Discounts include 35% for part-time practice (20 hours a week or less) and 5% for a risk management course. A student program, underwritten by Allied World Specialty Insurance Company, covers field placements only, and student rates are published. The agency also insures other professions, so it is not mental-health-only.
one_liner: Claims-made malpractice programs for psychiatrists, psychologists, counselors and MFTs.
best_for: American Psychiatric Association members looking at the association-selected malpractice program
Psychologists who want an American Psychological Association program with a 20% member discount
Counselors and MFTs who want $1M/$3M claims-made cover with no deductible and no membership requirement
Part-time clinicians (20 hours a week or less), who get a 35% discount
Graduate students who need field-placement liability cover
not_for: Clinicians who want occurrence coverage by default; the counselor policy is claims-made and the tail costs 200% of the expiring premium
Psychiatrists who are not American Psychiatric Association members, since that program is limited to members
Students who need cover for paid employment; the student policy covers field placement only

Discounts: 35% part-time, 5% risk management course, 20% for American Psychological Association members on the psychologist program. Student rates are published on the vendor's student-rates page.

faqs.q: Is American Professional Agency the insurance company?
faqs.a: No. It is an agency and program administrator. Its counselor and MFT program is underwritten by Allied World Insurance Company, and its student program by Allied World Specialty Insurance Company.

faqs.q: Is American Professional Agency coverage occurrence or claims-made?
faqs.a: The mental health counselor policy is claims-made. A tail costs 200% of the expiring premium, but is free on death, permanent disability, or retirement at 55 or older after five years on the policy. Prior-acts coverage is available when switching carriers.

faqs.q: What limits does American Professional Agency offer counselors?
faqs.a: Standard limits are $1,000,000 per incident and $3,000,000 aggregate, with up to $2,000,000/$4,000,000 available. There is no deductible.

faqs.q: Does it include licensing board defense?
faqs.a: Yes. The counselor policy includes $5,000 for licensing board complaints with no annual aggregate, and the limit can be raised to $150,000 for an additional charge.
